title: Pan-Seared Sea Bass with Mediterranean Skewers
description: A flavorful and healthy dish featuring pan-seared sea bass served with a colorful Mediterranean skewer. This recipe is perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: Soak the wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Add the sliced bell peppers, halved tomatoes, and chopped parsley to the bowl.
Toss to coat the vegetables with the marinade.
Thread the marinated vegetables onto the soaked skewers.
Season the sea bass fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Sear the sea bass fillets for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes.
Serve the pan-seared sea bass with the Mediterranean skewers.
